definitions.explanation: lacking fairness or justice, especially in how people or situations are treated

examples.japanese: {不公正|ふこうせい}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧だ。
{不公正|ふこうせい}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}した→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧。
examples.english: I protested against the unjust treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不公正|ふこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are organizations working to correct social injustice.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (non-/un-) and ⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧ (fairness/justice). Used as both a na-adjective ({不公正|ふこうせい}な) and a noun ({不公正|ふこうせい}). Common in formal discussions about social issues, legal matters, and business practices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: unfair transaction
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: unjust treatment
- {不公正|ふこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧: to correct injustice
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不公正|ふこうせい}: social injustice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不公平|ふこうへい}→不公平：16851_fukouhei⟧: unfair — focuses on unequal distribution or treatment between people
- ⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧: unjust, unreasonable — broader, can mean inappropriate or undeserved
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧: dishonest, fraudulent — implies deliberate wrongdoing or corruption
